lines.text: He pushed his car to a hotel. And instantly, he was bankrupt.
The surgeon was the boy's mother.  Most people picture a man.  That's the trap.
CCTV log · Cam 02 · Hotel car park · 23:10
A man pushes his car, by hand, all the way to the front of a hotel.
He stops.  Looks at the owner.  And says:  I'm bankrupt.
No crash. No theft. No one else touched the car.  So what happened?
Clue.  The hotel is red.  And the whole town fits on a table.
Answer in the comments.  And send it to the friend who always wins at Business.
He pushed his car to a hotel.  Why?
